# Mohammad Mehdi Sadeghi — Frontend Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio and technical showcase of Frontend Developer Mohammad Mehdi Sadeghi.

## Summary
Mohammad Mehdi Sadeghi is a Frontend Developer specializing in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, and WordPress. Educated at Rokad Startup School, he builds responsive, high-performance web applications, custom UI components, and modern interactive experiences.

## Technical Skills
- Core: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript
- Frameworks & Libraries: React, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Next.js
- CMS: WordPress
- Disciplines: Frontend Architecture, Responsive Web Design, Component Systems, UI/UX Engineering

## Featured Projects
- **CacheCleaner**: Windows utility for per-application cache cleanup and storage optimization.
- **NetBridge**: Developer network proxy & bridging utility for reliable local routing.
- **Rokad Web**: Modern creative design studio website built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
- **Porskad**: Form and survey management system for educational institutions with responsive admin UI.
- **Study Timer**: Study tracking and exam countdown web application.
- **Sabz Learn**: Responsive online learning platform interface with course catalog.
- **Ubisoft Clone**: Interactive web clone of Ubisoft website.
- **DigiKala Clone**: Responsive e-commerce catalog clone.

## Articles
- [Stop guessing at responsive bugs. Measure them.](https://mohammad-mehdi-sadeghi.vercel.app/blog/stop-guessing-at-responsive-bugs): Analysis of CSS overflow, border overlap, and real-browser viewport measurement techniques.
- [The React StrictMode bug that looked like a browser glitch](https://mohammad-mehdi-sadeghi.vercel.app/blog/react-strictmode-cleanup-bug): Deep dive into React StrictMode double-mount lifecycle and effect cleanup edge cases.
